description: Check a Phở analysis started with run_analysis. Waits up to wait_seconds for it to move, then returns its phase: running, plan_review (with the proposed plan and the ids approve_analysis_plan needs), done (with the report as Markdown) or failed. Progress notes are short Vietnamese messages from Phở; key off phase.

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to this many seconds (0–45) for the run to reach the plan or the report.
